description_en: Enables one or more alert rules
description_zh: 调用EnableMetricRules接口启用一个或多个报警规则
name: EnableMetricRules

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the alert rule.

Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an alert rule, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114941.html
parameters.help_zh:
报警规则ID。

N的取值范围：1~100。

关于如何获取报警规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114941.html
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run only. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run only and does not bind a security group to the instance. The system checks whether all required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the service limits are met. If the request fails the check, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the check, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request. If the request passes the check, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会为实例绑定安全组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

Code.description_en:
The status code.

A value of 200 indicates success

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: The operation was successful.
false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。
false：失败
